concept: IAM: permission boundary as a ceiling on delegated permissions
tests: Limiting the maximum permissions of roles that developers create themselves.
expected: A permission boundary on created roles: effective permissions = intersection of the boundary and attached policies. Triggers: "delegate role creation", "never exceed a set of permissions".
why_not: SCPs do not apply to the management account; a resource-based policy controls access to a resource, not a role's permission ceiling; an IAM group only groups users.
